call_points.text: Prospective bid pipeline is about ₹2.5 lakh crore; management does not revise it quarter to quarter.
Q1 capex ₹170 Cr against a FY27 budget of ₹500 Cr, which management reiterated.
Steel and cement prices are flat, but petroleum-linked commodities, aluminium, copper and OFC cables have risen; 81% of contracts carry price-escalation clauses.
BharatNet has ₹6,500 Cr left to execute on a fixed-price contract; rising OFC prices may cut profit, and management is seeking client relief.
Management withheld FY27 guidance citing too many variables and global uncertainty.
Consolidated order book reached a record ₹83,004 Cr as of March 31, 2026.

operating_notes.text: NCC bagged four orders worth ₹1,703.27 Cr in April 2026, with ₹930 Cr in Buildings, ₹603 Cr in Electrical, and ₹170 Cr in Transportation.
FY26 revenue moderation reflects funding-cycle stress in water and state-funded segments.
Consolidated order book stood at ₹83,004 Cr at the end of FY26, providing a book-to-bill ratio of roughly 4x.
NCC received orders worth ₹1,837.01 Cr in May 2026, including ₹1,289.17 Cr in Water, ₹261.42 Cr in Buildings, and ₹286.42 Cr in Electrical.
Order book of ₹81,214 Cr comprises ₹71,312 Cr standalone and ₹9,902 Cr from subsidiaries, with orders spanning 2 to 7 years.
Ken-Betwa order value is ₹3,390 Cr, of which ₹116.35 Cr has been executed; the site is fully mobilised.
BharatNet has ₹6,500 Cr left to execute on a fixed-price contract; ₹185 Cr was recognised in Q1 and ₹620 Cr cumulatively.
Received 8 non-major orders totaling ₹1,862.45 Cr in October 2026 spanning Water (₹767.11 Cr), Buildings (₹688.78 Cr), and Transportation (₹406.56 Cr) divisions with 24-36 months execution period.

timeline.summary: NCC received four orders totaling ₹1,703.27 Cr across its Buildings, Electrical, and Transportation divisions during April 2026.
AAV Ranga Raju, as Chief Promoter, declared no encumbrances on promoter shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,232.71 Cr (+1.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹206.02 Cr (-18.8% YoY).
NCC reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹20,823 Cr and an order book of ₹83,004 Cr.
NCC Limited shared the audio recording of its conference call on May 16, 2026, discussing audited financial results for Q4 FY2026 and FY2026 via its website.
NCC reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,251 Cr and a record order book of ₹83,004 Cr.
NCC secured orders worth ₹1,837.01 crore in May 2026, led by the Water Division.
On its 7 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, NCC guided FY27 order inflow at ₹22,000-25,000 Cr, revenue growth of 8-10% and EBITDA margin of 8.5-9%, against an order book of ₹81,214 Cr.
NCC received eight non-major orders totaling ₹1,862.45 crore across water, buildings, and transportation divisions in October 2026.
